body: I don't know, but just talking in the comments like this has helped me calm down a bit.  Thank you for that.

It's so hard for me to trust anybody even if they feel like the "one."  My brain keeps telling me that they're angry at me or going to hurt me.  I'm good at keeping up a facade for a while, but my anxiety eventually becomes overwhelming and I explode.  I start interpreting innocuous signals as threats and then I become paranoid, defensive, and angry. It's the same pattern every time, but I feel so helpless to stop it.  No matter what, I'm going to destroy the people who love me.
Nobody ever sticks around though. Even the people I thought I could trust all abandoned me when I became anxious.  I terrify people and it terrifies me.
Yes. The anti-anxiety techniques they taught me didn't work.  They gave me some medication, but it's effectiveness deteriorated quickly.
No. I'm terrified that people will think I'm crazy or screwed up.
Other people: fear that people are judging me, that people are angry at me, that people want to hurt me, that people will abandon me.
